reel.title: yaPDP - PDP-11/70 web emulator - full demo reel
reel.description: Every guest OS demo in one continuous reel: DEC BASIC-11, UNIX V5, 2.11 BSD, RT-11, XXDP diagnostics and Lunar Lander on the VT11 display, running on a faithful PDP-11/70 emulator with its original control panel.
